function.description: Search Trench Express launchpad tokens by name or symbol on Robinhood Chain (4663). COVERAGE: only tokens launched on Trench Express - never other Robinhood pools. Returns matching rows with token address, name, symbol, creator, curve-vs-graduated status, launchedAtMs (registry creation time, ms epoch), display-grade price, links, and an image URL. A row also carries isOwnLaunch when it can be determined: true means YOUR OWN wallet created that token, false means a different, known creator; the field is ABSENT when the launchpad reported no creator or your wallet could not be resolved, which means undetermined and never not-yours. Use to resolve a token the user names before browsing its tape. ETH curve only. Read-only.
function.name: trench__tokens_search

limit.description: Max results to return, 1-30 (provider-capped). Default leaves it to the provider.

query.description: Name or symbol fragment to search for.
